correctness.rationale: The published six difference cycles reconstruct 77 tetrahedra with face vector (14,91,154,77). Exact F_3 boundary ranks are 13 and 77, giving one-dimensional H_1. An explicit nontrivial cocycle vanishes on all 154 triangular faces and exhaustively classifies all 210 empty triangles as 28 null and 182 nonzero; direct cyclic-orbit enumeration gives 2 null and 13 essential orbits. The 182 detected 3-cycles attain the universal three-edge lower bound for a simple cycle.

value.rationale: The 14-vertex complex is a canonical transitive cyclic lens-space triangulation, and three edges are the absolute minimum support of a simple cycle. The order-three homology of L(3,1) makes F_3 the natural coefficient field. A complete classification of all minimum-length cycles into 13 essential symmetry orbits and two exceptional null orbits is therefore a structural local-to-global invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
